newsitem.title: USA: EDITEK Inc issues shares, settles 3 suits.
newsitem.headline: EDITEK Inc issues shares, settles 3 suits.

text.p: EDITEK Inc said on Thursday it issued 10.4 million common-stock shares to holders of its Series A Preferred Stock, and settled three lawsuits brought by preferred holders seeking conversion to common shares.

The company had faced five lawsuits by preferred shareholders who wanted to convert but could not because the company did not have enough authorized, unissued shares. In December, shareholders approved an increase from 30 million to 60 million common shares.
EDITEK said it is currently negotiating with other preferred shareholders involved in a lawsuit about the conversion and expects to have all the suits resolved soon.
The preferred shares were issued in January 1996 to help finance EDITEK's acquisition of MEDTOX Laboratories Inc.
EDITEK provides diagnostic kits for on-site analysis of drugs of abuse and toxins in agricultural products.
